body.approach: Add a Pareto cost check (beats_pareto) alongside beats_linear in judge.py and surface Ir/item in propose.py.
body.diff:
--- a/runner/proposals/judge.py
+++ b/runner/proposals/judge.py
@@ -52,4 +52,5 @@
     v["valid"] = mf >= 3 * sf and mf > 0
     if lin:
         ml, sl = paired(c["items"], lin["items"])
-        v.update(over_linear=ml, over_linear_se=sl, beats_linear=v["valid"] and ml > 2 * sl)
+        cost_ok = c.get("ir_per_item") is not None and lin.get("ir_per_item") is not None and c["ir_per_item"] <= lin["ir_per_item"]
+        v.update(over_linear=ml, over_linear_se=sl, beats_linear=v["valid"] and ml > 2 * sl, beats_pareto=v["valid"] and ml > 2 * sl and cost_ok)
body.risk: Leaderboard consumers must also check beats_pareto.
alternatives: Filter by Ir/item <= mlp16 before ranking.

body.approach: Make reserve() accumulate pending[run] and pending_usd[run] additively (+=) and reserve worst-case per-call cost.
body.risk: Tighter reservations may trigger budget waits slightly earlier.
alternatives: Reconcile actual vs pending after every job and pause at 95% of cap.

body.approach: Move QUEUE, RENDER, QUEUE_MD, and BRANCH to env/CLI config with neutral defaults.
body.risk: Requires one-time migration of the active queue file.

body.approach: Wrap valgrind in runner/limits.c in confine mode and bound /w disk usage.
body.risk: Valgrind needs a higher --as limit than bare infer.c.
alternatives: Require bwrap --size everywhere and deprecate confine for count.py.

body.approach: Convert exagium_seccomp to an explicit syscall allowlist for infer.c.
body.risk: Newer glibc versions may invoke extra syscalls (e.g. rseq, faccessat2).
alternatives: Keep denylist for Python train.py and strict allowlist for C infer.c.

body.approach: Assert semantic invariants rather than hardcoded line numbers and exact full-line strings.
body.risk: Looser checks may accept awkward phrasing.
alternatives: Keep canary3 as a strict regression fixture and add separate invariant tests.

body.approach: Checkpoint top P5 Pareto winners through a pre-registered held-out test entry in ledger/.
body.risk: None; aligns P5 with P5b held-out discipline.
alternatives: Require held-out confirmation before updating LEADERBOARD.md.

body.approach: Disambiguate the 0.980 vs 0.977 mlp16 optdigits dev numbers in README.md with run IDs.
alternatives: Update both sections to cite the same run.

body.approach: Change if not edits: in apply() to return 'no_edits' (or 'failed') instead of 'pr'.
body.risk: Ensure transitions.py maps 'no_edits' to open/escalated cleanly.
alternatives: Reject empty edit lists in check_edits before apply().

body.approach: Require verdict == 'approve' explicitly in apply(), normalize paths in allowed(), and re-verify edits sequentially.
alternatives: Add unit tests in test_code_job.py for unknown verdicts and ./ prefix paths.

body.approach: Pass allow_paid=True as an explicit argument to engines.call() instead of mutating os.environ.
alternatives: Guard paid-pool calls with a threading.Lock if env var must stay.

body.approach: Populate EST_MILLI_USD for drafter, reviewer, coder, and code_reviewer (or compute from max_tokens).
alternatives: Raise KeyError if PAID_FALLBACK=1 is used on a slot missing from EST_MILLI_USD.
